path_base: All provenance paths relative to biomedical_research/.
purpose: Cross-project exposure inventory before cycle-2 screening; no new case admission or scientific analysis.

scope.method: rg discovery; targeted protocol/admission/source-manifest and metadata checks; bounded broad alias and source-screen/code-identity search; classifications use canonical records.
limitations: Minimum verified index, not proof of universal unseen status.
A few broad search/status matches incidentally displayed old aggregate source-audit or result-narrative snippets; none were used to choose a candidate.
No patient table/raw dataset opened, web request/download/model run/new analysis performed.
A new folder, Agent, split, endpoint or mirror does not reset family exposure.
Source literature audit is not necessarily admitted evidence or microdata use.

role_definitions.source_only: Prior source evidence used/admitted; item-specific qualifiers apply.
role_definitions.development_target: Prepared/used/reused target; do not presume freshness.
role_definitions.revealed_confirmation_target: Historically reserved target now recorded as completed/revealed.
role_definitions.metadata_only: Release/design/access metadata inspected, no outcome analysis established.
role_definitions.source_literature_audit: Published source inspected/extracted; downstream use may remain unresolved.
role_definitions.uncertain_prior_use: No positive role established, not proof unseen.
